answer_1.quote: We propose Think-Before-Speaking (TBS), an RG framework that trains the RG model to explicitly generate the implicit knowledge and use this knowledge to generate a response
answer_1.outputs: Generated implicit knowledge and dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation We use standard natural language generation metrics such as BLEU , METEOR , ROUGE , CIDEr and SkipThoughts . We also use GRADE ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct extensive human evaluation using 300 randomly sampled instances ... using three annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT).
answer_4.guideline: For response quality, we conduct pairwise comparison ... based on different criteria ... We evaluate on six dimensions: which response is more grammatical, coherent, engaging, informative, specific, and makes common sense. For knowledge quality, we evaluate the generated knowledge in isolation ("does this knowledge make sense") and in conjunction with the context for relevance.
